role: independent source-audit lane; no product edits or runtime verification
scope: Remaining user-visible live page results/actions after shared document identity migration. URL/domain historical lookup is separated explicitly.
method: Inspected current source plus the D59 attack, partial repair/peer reports, and stabilization inventory. Source establishes admission paths and missing identity checks; it does not prove a runtime failure.

ranked_remaining.surface: Scrape manual capture, saved draft, and Diagnose picker
source_proof: src/hooks/use-scrape.ts:100-153 queries active tab independently, optionally awaits scrolling, captures by tabId+URL, then writes shared scrape store without document identity or current-page check
src/hooks/use-scrape.ts:180-208 saves whichever shared current capture is present
src/state/scrape.ts:16-25 stores current/original without page provenance; setCurrent replaces global draft
src/hooks/use-scrape.ts:66-92 handles picker result/exit without tab, document, or session admission
ranked_remaining.repro_sequence: Start fast/deep capture or Diagnose on A; reload A to same URL; allow A work or picker message to finish after B is current; inspect Scrape draft and attempt Save/diagnosis actions.
ranked_remaining.expected: Capture, edits, diagnose result, and save remain bound to their originating pageKey/document; A completion cannot replace B draft or be saved as B. A retained A draft must be visibly identified and must not present B as its page.
ranked_remaining.qualification: Source shows no shared document admission on these paths; whether timing yields a visible stale result requires runtime reproduction.

ranked_remaining.surface: Automatic scrape and chat context cache
source_proof: src/hooks/use-auto-scrape.ts:62-113 awaits scroll/capture, checks returned URL only, then stores soup
src/state/auto-scrape.ts stores current capture by URL/time (hook references)
ranked_remaining.repro_sequence: With auto-scrape enabled, complete capture on A, reload same URL to B within the freshness window or hold A capture until B is current; inspect chat context / auto-scrape store.
ranked_remaining.expected: A is invalidated on document replacement; automatic work is tied to the captured document and cannot repopulate the active cache after B becomes current. Same-URL B receives a fresh capture when configured.
ranked_remaining.qualification: The source's same-URL freshness shortcut and URL-only completion check leave this possibility open; no runtime failure is claimed.

ranked_remaining.repro_sequence: Start visible or full-page capture on A, reload same URL before handler finishes, then inspect the completion notice and gallery.

ranked_remaining.qualification: View source does not prove the handler's internal target or persisted document metadata; inspect handler and reproduce before asserting misattribution.
